# Beacon — Design Notes

## Source

ColorLib Halo: https://preview.colorlib.com/theme/halo/
Photography portfolio one-page template.

## Layout

- Navbar: logo left, nav links right, search icon
- Hero: full-width bg image, centered text overlay
- Intro: 2-column (4/8 split), text left, image right
- Portfolio: CSS grid, 3 cols, 7 items, hover overlay
- Milestones: 4-column stat counters, icon + number + label
- Services: 2-column (offset left text, right 2x2 grid of icon cards)
- Contact: bg image, 2-column (info left, form right)
- Footer: centered CTA + email, social icons row, copyright

## Tokens

- Open Sans (Google Fonts), weights 300-700
- Heading: #222121, Body: #868686
- Button: transparent bg, top+bottom 2px borders, uppercase, letter-spacing
- Section padding: 130px vertical, 150px horizontal
